The NSPCC said Instagram was recorded as the method of communication for child groomers 428 times between April and September 2018. This was a 239% increase on, or more than triple, the 126 instances over the same period in 2017.

It meant that 22% of all 1,944 grooming offences recorded by 39 of the UK's 43 police forces last year occurred on the Facebook-owned social network.

Police also broke down which online platforms were used by groomers across 1,317 cases. Predatory behavior on Instagram made up 32% of these cases, comfortably ahead of Facebook and Snapchat, which were used in 23% and 14% of child grooming instances respectively. Other platforms used for child grooming included Twitter and the game House Party.

This was a holdover going back to the Revolution and the impact the British left on Colonial troops was huge. Literally the British could not wait for the volley firing to end so they could get into it with bayonets. In turn that required a strong rifle, it essentially became a polearm. Look at how an 1863 Springfield pattern musket is built. Everything from the barrel bands back to the action & stock is robust to handle thrust & parry of bayonet use.

A lever gun cannot handle that type of work. If the magazine tube is dented the gun may not cycle and the 2-piece stock is weak compared to single piece ones and would break. You can make the case lever-action guns would have mitigated bayonet duels but it was entrenched mindset within the military for 75 years.

The Civil War Sharps was a breech loader but still used a paper cartridge and percussion cap. The big improvement of the Sharps (besides the obvious breech loading) was that the action snipped off the end of the paper cartridge like scissors when you closed it. Paper cartridges though were still finicky to load. They used nitrated-paper (so it burned up when fired) and it had the consistency of slightly stiffer cigarette paper. You couldn't just jam it into the action like a metallic cartridge. And, you still had to add the percussion cap to set it off though which is an extra operation.
